A mixed dinner plate: browned potato cubes, Brussels sprouts, what appears to be white fish, cottage cheese, and yellow fruit pieces that look like pineapple. A thick yellow sauce appears to cover some pieces; these identifications are somewhat uncertain.

**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**
